run_evaluation_episode: run a Stretch robot image navigation evaluation episode using the ImageNavAgent and record the resulting video
create_stretch_env: create a StretchImageNavEnv instance with a config to set up the navigation environment for evaluation
create_imagenav_agent: create an ImageNavAgent instance with a config to control navigation actions during an episode
switch_navigation_mode: switch the StretchImageNavEnv to navigation mode before starting an evaluation episode
record_navigation_video: record a video from saved image frames after completing a navigation episode
